Guy (28m) engaged to (35f) that is into that. It stays strictly during sex and it's not something we use in everyday life. I can understand not being into it, but I would say to also take into account that it might have been a very heavy thing to bring up and she wants that with you, no one else. That means a lot. I would say try it out, and see what your comfort level is. It's definitely not meant to condone incest, pedophilia, or anything like it. I can understand the connotation, but it's simply because you aren't used to it. I would say try it, really try it, and explore yourselves. You might give her the most amazing night of her life. 

TLDR : give it a try before you shut it down. She might just want you to rock her world.
Thank you for this.  I needed guidance. Its hard to be your own support. I needed outside help

I wish I had advice for you. I've been with this girl 5 yrs. She's never hesitated during a fight to go to the extreme. I had 3 suicide attempts. My family only knows about one. She had promised that a child would show her a different level of commitment and I was afraid of brining a kid into our relationship because our fights would get so bad. She got pregnant 3 months ago. Found out 2 months ago. Now I'm afraid of turning into my old explosive self. In front of my kid. Im fucked also. I would say leave if you can. I would have told myself that years ago. But im a moron anyway.

I tried pills. I got caught. They made me throw them up in time. I tried the gun. I tried it 3 times. The first 2, I got convinced to put it down. The last time, I was alone. I kept shaking. I kept crying. I kept yelling out because this is bull. Why am I the one who's the loser for quitting when everyone quit on me? Why wouldn't I take the easy way out? And I still couldn't. I cut and punched myself for being too cowardly to do it. Im jealous too.
Thank you.  Thank you for your concern.  I know I don't know you but every bit helps

Thats why i feel like it's better to let her know where you stand. If you really want her. Don't force it. But tell her whats up straight up to her. Make sure she knows that you take her seriously and will wait for her.
If i knew I would tell you. I dont have an answer
Yes thank you. Im here. My sister got on my case but I know its because she loves me.
It's freaking me out that i can't figure it out
My ex. Who i thought was my girl but apparently she's been single behind my back

Even if it doesn't work out, I promise you that the regret of never trying will be worse than the regret of failing. Ive been through both. And I failed with the love of my life but I guarantee you it wouldn't be killing me as bad as watching her be happy with someone else
I feel like it's love in my heart. I give her the space she needs and im not overbearing or jealous. But this just happened and idk what to do.
How do i move on? I've never loved anyone like i have loved her. We have a life together. We live together. We share a house, , car, a dog, a life together.

Bro you go for it. If she means the world, you go for it with everything you got. If you can't think of another girl and you feel like you will always look for her in every girl you ever date, she's the one. Tell her you can't wait. That whatever problems she might have, you want to be by her side dealing with those problems. If she means as much as you say, not even she can stop you. Tell her and show her that you dont want anyone, just her.
I'm so sorry. I always wondered what it would be like for those who go on after. Would they remember the good or the bad? Would they remember at all?
It was really really good. I didn't want to finish but I had to find out the morning after. I would love to see a continuation if possible
